name: Fusion
description:
The Vibe: Bold, vibrant, and unapologetically confident.

The Scent Journey: Starts with an energetic explosion of fresh citrus and juicy, ripe fruits, seasoned with a subtle touch of aromatic sweetness and spice. The dry-down reveals a powerful, commanding base of rich woods, smoky accents, rugged leather, and deep musky accords.

Best For: The modern man who wants a warm, long-lasting fragrance that commands the room.
